seo.title: Sandals Royal Curaçao: Couples-Only Honeymoon 2026
seo.description: Couples-only all-inclusive on Spanish Water, 351 suites, Butler Elite. Honest 2026 verdict, real cost, best suite, 7-night Curaçao itinerary.

content.verdict: Sandals Royal Curaçao opened in 2022 as Sandals' first Dutch-Caribbean flagship and remains the only true couples-only all-inclusive on the island — a 351-suite resort on the calm Spanish Water lagoon with the classic Sandals formula (unlimited dining at 11 specialty restaurants, premium liquor, butler-level Rondoval suites, golf included, watersports unlimited) finally available in a no-hurricane destination. The architecture is a step away from the brand's pastel beach hotel norm: Dutch-Caribbean curved-gable inspired facades, a multi-level infinity pool stack, and a much larger landscaped footprint than the older Sandals Caribbean resorts. For honeymooners who want the all-inclusive value and zero-friction butler experience but cannot accept the hurricane-season risk of Jamaica, Antigua, or St Lucia, this is the answer.
content.best_room: The signature Royal Curaçao suite is the Awa Seaside Bungalow Butler Suite — freestanding cottages on the beach with private patio plunge pools, hammocks, outdoor showers, and Sandals Butler Elite service (the white-jacket butlers who unpack, set the bath, reserve restaurants, and arrange the in-villa breakfasts). For higher tier, the Kurason Island Poolside Butler Suites sit in the centre of a private adults-only pool peninsula. Skip the standard Luxury rooms — at Sandals the butler tier is where the honeymoon value lives.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Arrival & Butler Welcome
itinerary_7_nights.description: Fly into Hato International (CUR), 15-minute Sandals private transfer to Spanish Water. The Butler Elite team meets you at arrival, hands you the suite mobile number, unpacks luggage, sets the bath, and reserves dinners for the week. First evening at Toteki — the Dutch-Caribbean signature restaurant — followed by the lobby bar.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Beach, Pool & Resort Day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Use day two to map the property — Sandals Royal Curaçao has the brand's largest pool footprint with seven distinct pools, including the swim-up Aqua Bar. Morning at the private beach (calm Spanish Water side; a complimentary catamaran shuttle runs to a public Caribbean-side beach for waves). Lunch at Bayside (Mediterranean), spa appointment, then sushi dinner at Sora.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Pastel Willemstad Half-Day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Half-day excursion to Punda and Otrobanda — the UNESCO pastel facades along the Handelskade, the Queen Emma floating bridge, Mikve Israel-Emanuel (the oldest continuously-operating synagogue in the Americas, 1732). Sandals organises shared shuttles; private taxi is 20 minutes. Lunch at Plasa Bieu for keshi yena, return for sunset cocktails at Out West (Mexican).

itinerary_7_nights.title: Klein Curaçao Catamaran Day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Full-day catamaran from Spanish Water (Sandals partners with Mermaid and BlueFinn) to uninhabited Klein Curaçao — white sand, the historic lighthouse, abandoned shipwrecks, and the Dutch Caribbean's clearest snorkel water. Lunch on board, two snorkel stops, return by 5:30pm. This is not always included in the rate — check whether your dates have the complimentary excursion or whether it is the optional $150-per-couple add.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Golf or Sailing Day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Sandals Royal Curaçao includes Old Quarry Golf Course (the Pete Dye-designed 18-hole course at Santa Barbara Plantation, complimentary green fees for resort guests). Non-golfers can take the included Hobie Cat sailing lesson, paddleboard, or windsurf in Spanish Water. Afternoon at the Red Lane Spa — the couples massage in the open-air spa pavilion.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Westpunt & Mushroom Forest
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive north-west 50 minutes to Playa Kenepa Grandi (Curaçao's most beautiful Caribbean-side beach), or book the Ocean Encounters dive day to Mushroom Forest from Westpunt — coral mushroom field 15-25m, Blue Room sea cave snorkel for non-divers. Lunch at Sol Food. Final dinner at the candlelit beachside Butch's Chophouse for steak.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Final Pool Day & Departure
itinerary_7_nights.description: Final breakfast in-suite (butler service), last swim in the private plunge pool, and 15-minute Sandals transfer back to CUR. Departure schedules are well-handled — late checkout to 4pm is standard for honeymoon couples.

caveats: Sandals Royal Curaçao is on Spanish Water (calm inland lagoon) not the open Caribbean — the beach is small and the swimming is calm; a complimentary catamaran shuttles guests to a Caribbean-side beach with waves.
The property is large (351 suites) and busy by Sandals standards — couples wanting a small boutique resort should look at Baoase or Floris Suite Hotel instead.
Klein Curaçao day-trip is not consistently complimentary — confirm at booking whether your rate includes the catamaran day or whether it is the optional $150-per-couple add.
Curaçao is not the long-beach Caribbean of Aruba or Anguilla — Sandals' beach is functional, not iconic; couples expecting two-mile sand crescents should set expectations or pick Anguilla.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: Sandals Royal Curaçao is purpose-built for honeymooners and couples — 100% adults-only, Butler Elite service, the brand's renowned in-suite breakfast and private dinner setups, included specialty restaurants, and the no-hurricane Curaçao geography. The combination of all-inclusive simplicity and no-storm peace of mind is uniquely valuable for couples nervous about Caribbean weather risk.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: Curaçao is below the hurricane belt — Sandals Royal Curaçao is open and consistent year-round. The dry-season sweet spot is January-April: 28-30°C, breezy, dry. May-June and November are excellent shoulder months with lower rates. Even September-October (closed elsewhere for hurricanes) is open and operating here.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: Awa Seaside Bungalow Butler Suites (the freestanding beach cottages) book 4-6 months ahead for the December-April peak. Kurason Island Butler Suites have more flexibility. Sandals' honeymoon-specific incentives (free butler upgrades, suite credits) are best booked through certified Sandals Specialist agents who unlock the unpublished offers.

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: Yes — Sandals Royal Curaçao is strictly adults-only (18+) and couples-only (heterosexual and same-sex couples both welcome since 2014). No children, no families, no exceptions. This is the Curaçao option for couples who want a guaranteed kid-free environment.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Awa Seaside Bungalow Butler Suite is the signature honeymoon room — freestanding beach cottage, private plunge pool, hammock, outdoor shower, Butler Elite. For the Sandals overwater experience, Curaçao does not have the overwater bungalows of Sandals Royal Caribbean (Jamaica) or Sandals Saint Vincent — those are the bucket-list categories elsewhere in the brand.

faqs.question: How to get there?
faqs.answer: Hato International (CUR) is 15 minutes from Sandals Royal Curaçao. Direct flights from JFK (American, JetBlue), Miami (American), Newark (United), Atlanta (Delta seasonal), Amsterdam (KLM, TUI). Sandals includes a private airport transfer in every booking — meet the Sandals rep at the lounge directly inside the terminal.
